title: Evasive
summary: EVA'SIVE, adjective Using evasion or artifice to avoid; elusive; shuffling; equivocating. He--answered evasive of the sly request. 1. Containing evasion; artfully contrived to elude a question, charge

inlines.v: EVA'SIVE, adjective Using evasion or artifice to avoid; elusive; shuffling; equivocating. He--answered evasive of the sly request. 1. Containing evasion; artfully contrived to elude a question, charge or argument; as an evasive answer; an evasive argument or reasoning.
